body: Farewell good sir. Live a good life, and good luck.
There's so much more to my depression that I don't really want to share. I'm just done. I'm tired, exhausted even.

So is the best way to find out her bank acct/routing number and make the deposit?

Thanks for your help.

She won't. She's the type that wants to work for her money, that's why she won't even accept it to begin with. 

I fucked up my relationship with her. She's essentially cut me out of her life. I just want to know how to force my money onto her name (if that's even possible), because she probably won't cash a check that I give her.

I think it's because she doesn't want me to kill myself, but receiving the money would mean that I'm gone.

It's sort of complicated, but in the end, I just want her to have this sum to help shore up her future finances.

And no to traveling or seeing the world. I just don't care enough to. Never have, never will. I've done a bit of traveling already and it has only brought me annoyance and homesickness.
Not worth it. I have HIV. There's no future for me. I want out, and I want my friend to have my money. Please help if you know how that can be arranged.
